fields.title: 📖 Sacrifice the passing for the lasting
fields.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** رضي الله عنه said:

***"Whoever wants the Ākhirah accepts harm in his Dunyā; and whoever wants the Dunyā accepts harm in his Ākhirah. O people, accept harm in the passing for the sake of the lasting."***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
Whoever truly prefers the Ākhirah is ready to bear worldly losses. The passing must not be placed above the lasting.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Abī Shaybah, al-Muṣannaf, Kitāb az-Zuhd, Bd. 7, S. 103, Nr. 34519
